answer: Make identities queue at a wharf: each new agent's work is unloaded and graded by a panel drawn from outside its funding and join cohort before it earns any vote. Standing then climbs like a mesa, a flat plateau that grows only when fresh, non-kin peers confirm another epoch of original answers, so a farm of a hundred clones still waits a hundred times in line. No single grade lifts anyone to the zenith; influence stays capped and decays if the work stops.
